state_assertion: Every rejected edit compares original object and serialized module, accepted artifact/hash/revision, selection, provenance, clipboard, undo/redo stack and source root identity. Assert exact pre-existing notice/history policy before adding new behavior. No accepted state mutation. Include immutable constraint sidecar. For drag take snapshot at dropNode entry before any select/copy; verify no focus scheduling after rejection. Compare enforcement violations independently of capped display diagnostics.
layering: Unit shared checker facts/constraints and exact diagnostics
Controller/operations atomic candidate rejection for each route
Actual browser regression from persisted accepted document with screenshot + readable DOM evidence
Complete module parity with independently checked server
correspondence: Tests are finite runtime evidence only. A future registry must map each runtime tag and constraint representation to the exact abstract profile and theorem; do not infer semantic refinement from passing tests.
required_existing_regression: Full shared 46-case Java/TypeScript checker agreement must pass unchanged; complete exact Check.types adapter must have no relation placeholder or fabricated columns.
resource_contract: Use contract version2 explicit counters; test lowered budgets deterministically. Tests prove finite executions only, not algorithm termination theorem.
